feed.title: Undertow · Bare Attrs
feed.subtitle: Elements a feed emits with no attributes at all, where normalise.html previously assumed a map

entry.title: Bare Link No Href
entry.content: An Atom <link> with no href= (or any) attribute unmarshals to a bare string, not a map.

entry.title: Bare Category No Term
entry.content: An Atom <category> with no term= attribute unmarshals to a bare string, not a map.
